class.name: OcgGraphic3dStructure
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition a graphic object. This graphic structure can be displayed, erased, or highlighted. This graphic structure can be connected with another graphic structure.
class.description: ! This class allows the definition a graphic object. ! This graphic structure can be displayed, erased, or highlighted. ! This graphic structure can be connected with another graphic structure.

method.name: Graphic3d_Structure
method.description: Creates a graphic object in the manager theManager. It will appear in all the views of the visualiser. The structure is not displayed when it is created.

method.name: Clear
method.description: if WithDestruction == Standard_True then suppress all the groups of primitives in the structure. and it is mandatory to create a new group in <me>. if WithDestruction == Standard_False then clears all the groups of primitives in the structure. and all the groups are conserved and empty. They will be erased at the next screen update. The structure itself is conserved. The transformation and the attributes of <me> are conserved. The childs of <me> are conserved.

method.name: Display
method.description: Displays the structure <me> in all the views of the visualiser.

method.name: DisplayPriority
method.description: Returns the current display priority for this structure.

method.name: SetDisplayPriority_1
method.description: Modifies the order of displaying the structure. Values are between 0 and 10. Structures are drawn according to their display priorities in ascending order. A structure of priority 10 is displayed the last and appears over the others. The default value is 5. Warning: If structure is displayed then the SetDisplayPriority method erases it and displays with the new priority. Raises Graphic3d_PriorityDefinitionError if Priority is greater than 10 or a negative value.

method.name: ResetDisplayPriority
method.description: Reset the current priority of the structure to the previous priority. Warning: If structure is displayed then the SetDisplayPriority() method erases it and displays with the previous priority.

method.name: Erase
method.description: Erases this structure in all the views of the visualiser.

method.name: Highlight
method.description: Highlights the structure in all the views with the given style

method.name: Remove_1
method.description: Suppress the structure <me>. It will be erased at the next screen update. Warning: No more graphic operations in <me> after this call. Category: Methods to modify the class definition

method.name: CalculateBoundBox
method.description: Computes axis-aligned bounding box of a structure.

method.name: SetInfiniteState
method.description: Sets infinite flag. When TRUE, the MinMaxValues method returns: theXMin = theYMin = theZMin = RealFirst(). theXMax = theYMax = theZMax = RealLast(). By default, structure is created not infinite but empty.

method.name: SetZLayer
method.description: Set Z layer ID for the structure. The Z layer mechanism allows to display structures presented in higher layers in overlay of structures in lower layers by switching off z buffer depth test between layers

method.name: GetZLayer
method.description: Get Z layer ID of displayed structure. The method returns -1 if the structure has no ID (deleted from graphic driver).

method.name: SetClipPlanes
method.description: Changes a sequence of clip planes slicing the structure on rendering.

method.name: ClipPlanes
method.description: Get clip planes slicing the structure on rendering.

method.name: SetVisible
method.description: Modifies the visibility indicator to Standard_True or Standard_False for the structure <me>. The default value at the definition of <me> is Standard_True.

method.name: SetVisual
method.description: Modifies the visualisation mode for the structure <me>.

method.name: SetZoomLimit
method.description: Modifies the minimum and maximum zoom coefficients for the structure <me>. The default value at the definition of <me> is unlimited. Category: Methods to modify the class definition Warning: Raises StructureDefinitionError if <LimitInf> is greater than <LimitSup> or if <LimitInf> or <LimitSup> is a negative value.

method.name: SetIsForHighlight
method.description: Marks the structure <me> representing wired structure needed for highlight only so it won't be added to BVH tree.

method.name: UnHighlight
method.description: Suppresses the highlight for the structure <me> in all the views of the visualiser.

method.name: computeHLR
method.description: Returns the new Structure defined for the new visualization

method.name: RecomputeTransformation
method.description: Calculates structure transformation for specific camera position

method.name: ReCompute_1
method.description: Forces a new construction of the structure <me> if <me> is displayed and TOS_COMPUTED.

method.name: ReCompute_2
method.description: Forces a new construction of the structure <me> if <me> is displayed in <aProjetor> and TOS_COMPUTED.

method.name: Groups
method.description: Returns the groups sequence included in this structure.

method.name: NumberOfGroups
method.description: Returns the current number of groups in this structure.

method.name: NewGroup
method.description: Append new group to this structure.

method.name: CurrentGroup
method.description: Returns the last created group or creates new one if list is empty.

method.name: HighlightStyle
method.description: Returns the highlight attributes.

method.name: IsDeleted
method.description: Returns TRUE if this structure is deleted (after Remove() call).

method.name: IsDisplayed
method.description: Returns the display indicator for this structure.

method.name: IsEmpty
method.description: Returns Standard_True if the structure <me> is empty. Warning: A structure is empty if : it do not have group or all the groups are empties and it do not have descendant or all the descendants are empties.

method.name: IsInfinite
method.description: Returns Standard_True if the structure <me> is infinite.

method.name: IsHighlighted
method.description: Returns the highlight indicator for this structure.

method.name: IsTransformed
method.description: Returns TRUE if the structure is transformed.

method.name: IsVisible
method.description: Returns the visibility indicator for this structure.

method.name: MinMaxValues
method.description: Returns the coordinates of the boundary box of the structure <me>. If <theToIgnoreInfiniteFlag> is TRUE, the method returns actual graphical boundaries of the Graphic3d_Group components. Otherwise, the method returns boundaries taking into account infinite state of the structure. This approach generally used for application specific fit operation (e.g. fitting the model into screen, not taking into account infinite helper elements). Warning: If the structure <me> is empty then the empty box is returned, If the structure <me> is infinite then the whole box is returned.

method.name: Visual
method.description: Returns the visualisation mode for the structure <me>.

method.name: DisconnectAll
method.description: If Atype is TOC_DESCENDANT then suppress all the connections with the child structures of <me>. If Atype is TOC_ANCESTOR then suppress all the connections with the parent structures of <me>.

method.name: HLRValidation
method.description: Hidden parts stored in this structure are valid if: 1) the owner is defined. 2) they are not invalid.

method.name: Transformation
method.description: Return local transformation.

method.name: SetTransformation
method.description: Modifies the current local transformation

method.name: SetTransformPersistence
method.description: Modifies the current transform persistence (pan, zoom or rotate)

method.name: TransformPersistence
method.description: Returns transform persistence of the presentable object.

method.name: SetMutable
method.description: Sets if the structure location has mutable nature (content or location will be changed regularly).

method.name: IsMutable
method.description: Returns true if structure has mutable nature (content or location are be changed regularly). Mutable structure will be managed in different way than static ones.

method.name: GraphicClear
method.description: Clears the structure <me>.

method.name: GraphicTransform
method.description: Internal method which sets new transformation without calling graphic manager callbacks.

method.name: Identification
method.description: Returns the identification number of this structure.

method.name: CStructure
method.description: Returns the low-level structure

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: PrintNetwork
method.description: Prints information about the network associated with the structure <AStructure>.
